input: Deep clean the bathroom tiles and grout

gold.taskTitle: Deep Clean Bathroom Tiles and Grout
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to deep clean their bathroom tiles and grout thoroughly.

questions.title: Which specific area needs cleaning: floor, walls, or both?
questions.description: Identify the exact tile surfaces that need to be deep cleaned.

questions.title: How large is the tiled area in square feet?
questions.description: Understand the size of the area to estimate time and materials needed.

questions.title: What is the current condition of the grout right now?
questions.description: Determine whether the grout has surface dirt, deep stains, mold, or mildew.

questions.title: Do you have cleaning supplies already, or need a shopping list?
questions.description: Find out if the user needs to source materials before starting.

questions.title: What type of tile material are you working with?
questions.description: Identify whether the tiles are ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, or another material, as this affects which cleaners are safe to use.

questions.title: Have you deep cleaned these tiles before, and how recently?
questions.description: Gauge the baseline condition and cleaning history to set expectations.

questions.title: Is there a specific date or deadline you want this done by?
questions.description: Understand any time constraints to help structure the plan around the user's schedule.
